schema.content:
Table "actor" {
  "ActorID" INTEGER [pk]
  "Name" TEXT
  "Date of Birth" DATE
  "Birth City" TEXT
  "Birth Country" TEXT
  "Height (Inches)" INTEGER
  "Biography" TEXT
  "Gender" TEXT
  "Ethnicity" TEXT
  "NetWorth" TEXT
}

Table "characters" {
  "MovieID" INTEGER [pk]
  "ActorID" INTEGER [pk]
  "Character Name" TEXT
  "creditOrder" INTEGER
  "pay" TEXT
  "screentime" TEXT
}

Table "movie" {
  "MovieID" INTEGER [pk]
  "Title" TEXT
  "MPAA Rating" TEXT
  "Budget" INTEGER
  "Gross" INTEGER
  "Release Date" TEXT
  "Genre" TEXT
  "Runtime" INTEGER
  "Rating" REAL
  "Rating Count" INTEGER
  "Summary" TEXT
}



Ref: "characters"."MovieID" > "movie"."MovieID"

Ref: "characters"."ActorID" > "actor"."ActorID"
